email.body1:
Jenna, saw Alianza put $200M into R&D and launched its Intelligent Communications Fabric for service providers.

Investment that big usually opens more in-market providers than the team can cover before the message lands everywhere it should. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alianza off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jenna, quick follow-up for Alianza.

With a $200M R&D bet, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alianza needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jenna, last bit of proof for Alianza.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alianza's reply rate likely compares to other cloud-comms teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jenna, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and a major R&D push is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your service-provider motion? I'll tailor it to Alianza either way.
